correctness.rationale: On Dic_n (n>=2), the missing-element identity expresses sum_A(|AA|-|AA^{-1}|) as a sum of cycle-independence counts. Rotation and nonrotation elements give the exact 2n-term formula with the nonrotation contribution -4n*7^(n-1). The independently derived Lucas recurrence reproduces M(29)=-203011530049362987071455440 and M(30)=397569666293094423242677920 and the signs for every 2<=n<=79. The displayed analytic lower bound normalized by 9^n is strictly positive at n=80 by rational arithmetic; its three adverse terms strictly decrease for n>=80, completing the infinite statement. Direct finite enumeration is corroboration, not substituted for the tail proof.
